fusions.name: Up the Falls
fusions.desc: Rushes you onto a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 14 damage, rising to 1.4 times that from the full 6 tiles. The target is left [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick-Rock Ram
fusions.desc: Rams a target carrying one of your afflictions and uses that affliction up. The ram deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 control conditions from you. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Riverstone Stride

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross rock
and the current feeds you as you cross
and nothing that has to swim can pin you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 12% faster over it, from silver your mana recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 10%.
